acq_time.Description: Acquisition time of the particular scan

duration.Description: Wallclock duration of the scan, in seconds, from the onset of the first to the end of the last acquired volume or sample. Estimated from the DICOM headers (see heudiconv.dicoms.get_acquisition_duration) or, retrospectively, from the NIfTI/JSON sidecar. See also https://github.com/bids-standard/bids-specification/pull/2508
